fact_text: Matco began in 1964 as MA Trading Company, founded by Syed Sarfaraz Ali Gauri with 70,000 rupees of capital and a typewriter, indenting for several companies including Japanese principals.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The group entered rice milling in 1970 with the Javed Rice Mill in Larkana, which was nationalised and later restarted after being returned to the family.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: After private rice exports were allowed in Pakistan, the family set up a modern rice processing unit in Karachi in 1989 as Matco Rice Processing, later known as Matco Foods Limited.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Matco started exporting in 1990, first through private-label packing and toll milling for other brands, and then built export markets through trade exhibitions and customer visits.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Matco launched its Falak basmati brand in 1999, and consumers in Pakistan and abroad know the company mainly through this brand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The Falak basmati brand is exported to about 45 countries, and the company describes it as one of Pakistan's leading rice brands.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Matco Foods as a company sells into about 65 countries, while its Falak brand reaches about 45 of them, according to the company's director.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Matco makes private-label rice for retailers including Coles, Woolworths, Dollar General and the UAE chain Lulu, so its rice reaches shelves under other brand names.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Falak is preferred in UK cities including Birmingham, the Midlands, Manchester and outer London, and Matco's rice reaches Tesco through millers rather than by direct supply.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Matco Foods has five business units: rice processing and export, rice-derived ingredients, corn starch, the Falak Foods spices and FMCG division, and a food-ingredients joint venture.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Broken rice from milling is converted into rice glucose, rice protein, maltodextrin and dextrose monohydrate, which go into pharmaceuticals, candy, confectionery and baking, and are exported.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The corn starch unit makes industrial-grade starch from maize for textiles, paper and corrugation, and also supplies starch for food applications.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The Falak Foods division makes spices, recipe mixes and FMCG food products, with about 90 products that use around 250 SKUs across different grades.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The company's director views Falak Foods as its fastest-growing segment and plans to invest more there, carrying the same quality and brand values as the rice business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Matco's food-ingredients joint venture in Pakistan is named Barentz Pakistan and is held with a Dutch company.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The International Finance Corporation, the World Bank arm, invested in Matco Foods in 2012, the first such investment in a rice and agro-processing business in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Matco Foods listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange through an IPO in 2018.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The interviewee joined the family business in 2006, and about eight cousins and siblings from the third generation run the company.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The company says it has become Pakistan's largest basmati rice exporter and consistently ranks among the top 100 exporters, focusing on basmati, rice glucose and corn starch.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The company's exports contribute roughly 70 million dollars to Pakistan's total exports, according to the company's director.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Pakistan's rice exports are worth about 4 billion dollars, making rice the largest food export category, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Rice is the second-largest export category in Pakistan overall, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The 2022 flood hit rice and other crops in Sindh hard, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The current flood's impact is greater in Punjab, with rice crop losses put at about 10 to 15 percent, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Farmers planted more rice in 2025, but the interviewee said climate change effects on crops are clearly visible in the sector.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Canal lining was improved near Matco's rice plant in Gujranwala, and the interviewee said that area escaped flood damage that hit it in 2014 and 2020.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Seed research in Pakistan includes heat-tolerant rice varieties that companies are introducing, and Matco works closely with farmers on such adaptation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: India's basmati prices are consistently lower than Pakistan's, which the interviewee attributed to heavy farm-level subsidies and certified-seed practices in India.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Pakistani basmati is priced about 200 to 300 dollars per ton higher than Indian basmati, yet buyers still take it for its taste.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Pakistan holds the majority share of basmati sales into the European Union, because EU pesticide-residue testing is stricter and tends to challenge Indian rice there.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Export demand for Falak is helped by Pakistani diaspora buyers, who prefer the brands they knew at home, so export sales respond to brand recall among them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Falak's brand promise is aged, pure basmati that cooks well, and the interviewee said customers buy basmati mainly for its aroma and grading.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Basmati processing runs from farmer paddy through drying, storage, ageing and milling, which separates small and broken grains, then colour sorting, leaving whole head grains for the consumer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Consumers increasingly prefer polyethylene (PE) bags over jute or cotton bags for rice, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: More than 80 percent of rice sold in Pakistan is still loose, unbranded rice, while about 20 percent is branded and packaged, according to market studies the interviewee cited.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: About 40 percent of buyers of branded rice have Falak as their top-of-mind brand, which the interviewee said makes it the number one rice brand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Falak's marketing covers social media, Ramadan television ads, print, radio, in-shop activation, cooking shows and college events, aiming for top-of-mind recall.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Matco began selling all Falak products in Azerbaijan by land route, and the company is seeking new distributors in new markets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Matco plans capacity expansions in its corn starch business, including grain storage, and in rice glucose production.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The interviewee sees very promising prospects over a 3 to 5 year horizon if national stability, interest rates and the foreign exchange rate hold steady.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: If no major macroeconomic shocks occur, food-processing businesses such as Matco can grow and invest, and flood and similar challenges can be absorbed, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Matco Food's Premium Falak Basmati Rice are World-Famous | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)
